highlights: Thailand's largest themed water park
5 zones: Naga Jungle, Great Andaman, Emerald Forest, Thai Mythical, Kiddie zone
World-class slides including body slides, tube slides, and multi-lane racers
Wave pool with artificial waves
Lazy river winding through the park
includes: Entry to all zones & water slides
Access to wave pool, lazy river, kids area
requirements: No outside food or drinks allowed

description_en: Full-day access to Thailand's largest themed water park (over 100,000 sqm) with world-class slides, lazy rivers, wave pools, and 5 themed zones inspired by Thai mythology. Open daily 10:00–18:00.
description_ru: Полный день в крупнейшем тематическом аквапарке Таиланда (более 100 000 м²) с горками мирового класса, ленивыми реками, бассейнами с волнами и 5 тематическими зонами по мотивам тайской мифологии. Ежедневно 10:00–18:00.

description_en: Indoor laser tag arena. Great for birthday parties and family competitions!
description_ru: Крытая арена лазертага. Отлично для дней рождения и семейных соревнований!

highlights: 150+ performers on Asia's largest stage
Rain, river & flying effects on stage
Pre-show village with elephant feeding
International buffet for 2,000 guests

itinerary.title_en: Gates open – Village of Arts
Buffet dinner

description_en: World-class cultural show featuring 150 performers, stunning stage effects, and traditional Thai buffet dinner. A journey through Thai history and mythology.
description_ru: Культурное шоу мирового класса: 150 артистов, потрясающие спецэффекты и традиционный тайский ужин-буфет. Путешествие по истории и мифологии Таиланда.

excludes: Lunch (program is half-day, morning or afternoon)

No riding, no tricks – elephants roam freely
Hand-feed elephants with fresh fruit
Observe elephants' mud bath & waterhole play
Learn rescue stories from passionate guides
Walk alongside elephants in natural jungle habitat

itinerary.title_ru: Забор из отеля на кондиционированном микроавтобусе

Walk to elephant habitat, meet the elephants
Feed elephants, observe mud bath & waterhole

requirements: Wear comfortable walking shoes (can get muddy)
Long pants recommended for jungle walking
Bring your own camera (no flash near elephants)
Be quiet and calm around elephants – guides will instruct
attributes.short_description: Ethical elephant sanctuary experience: observe rescued elephants roaming freely, canopy walkway, and vegetarian Thai meal.

description_en: Ethical half-day experience at Phuket Elephant Sanctuary – Phuket's first ethical elephant sanctuary. Observe, feed, and walk alongside rescued elephants in their natural habitat. No riding, no tricks, no chains. Learn each elephant's rescue story from expert guides. Includes mud bath and waterhole observation. Hotel transfer, fruit for feeding, and refreshments included.
description_ru: Этичная полудневная программа в Phuket Elephant Sanctuary – первом этическом слоновьем заповеднике Пхукета. Наблюдайте, кормите и гуляйте рядом со спасёнными слонами в естественной среде. Без катания, трюков и цепей. Узнайте историю каждого слона. Включены грязевые ванны, водопой, трансфер и угощения.
name_en: Half Day Program (Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Visit)

highlights: Thailand's biggest zipline park in pristine rainforest
Ziplines up to 400 meters long – soar above the jungle
16+ platforms connected by bridges & staircases
Abseil descent from treetop platform
Stunning views of Phuket's mountains & coastline
Professional Petzl safety equipment (European standard)
Suitable for ages 4–70, weight 20–120 kg

Zipline adventure through rainforest (16+ platforms)

attributes.short_description: Jungle zipline eco-adventure with fixed play times; transfer included.

description_en: Full zipline adventure package at Hanuman World – Thailand's biggest zipline park in Phuket's jungle mountains. Soar through the rainforest canopy on 16+ platforms connected by ziplines up to 400m long. Includes sky bridges, abseil descent, and spiral staircase. Round-trip hotel transfer, all equipment, and refreshments included.
description_ru: Полный зиплайн-пакет в Hanuman World – крупнейшем зиплайн-парке Таиланда в горных джунглях Пхукета. Пролетите через полог леса по 16+ платформам с зиплайнами до 400 м. Включены подвесные мосты, спуск по верёвке и винтовая лестница. Трансфер, оборудование и напитки включены.

excludes: Professional photos (bring your own camera/phone with dry bag)

30+ years rated #1 on TripAdvisor

requirements: Dry & warm clothes for the evening return
Camera or smartphone (at own risk, dry bags provided)
No minimum age but children must be supervised
Not recommended for severe claustrophobia (cave passages)
attributes.short_description: Signature afternoon sea-cave canoe tour: hidden lagoons in Phang Nga Bay.

description_en: John Gray's legendary evening kayaking tour through Phang Nga Bay sea caves and hidden hongs (collapsed cave lagoons). Departs mid-day to avoid crowds. Professional guide paddles you through tidal sea caves into hidden lagoons populated by macaques, water monitors, and sea eagles. Includes sunset dinner on the boat and bioluminescent plankton experience after dark. Custom SOTAR kayaks. 30+ years of operation, rated #1 on TripAdvisor.
description_ru: Легендарный вечерний каякинг-тур John Gray's Sea Canoe по морским пещерам и скрытым хонгам (обвалившимся лагунам) залива Пханг Нга. Отправление днём, чтобы избежать толп. Профессиональный гид проводит через приливные пещеры в скрытые лагуны с макаками, варанами и орлами. Ужин на закате и биолюминесцентный планктон после темноты. 30+ лет работы, #1 на TripAdvisor.
name_en: Hong by Starlight (Sea Cave Kayaking & Phang Nga Bay)
name_ru: Гонг при звёздах (каякинг в заливе Пханг Нга)

excludes: Additional park fees for certain islands

description_en: Private full-day sailing charter with Phuket Sail Tours. Explore Phang Nga Bay, Phi Phi Islands, or custom routes on your own schedule. Includes captain, crew, Thai lunch, snorkeling gear, and kayak. Perfect for families and groups up to 4 people. Uncrowded alternative to group tours.
description_ru: Частный парусный чартер на целый день с Phuket Sail Tours. Исследуйте залив Пханг Нга, острова Пхи-Пхи или индивидуальный маршрут в своём ритме. Включены капитан, команда, тайский обед, снорклинг и каяк. Идеально для семей и групп до 4 человек.
name_en: Private Boat Charter (Full Day) — Up to 4 People

description_en: Hands-on Thai cooking class at Phuket Thai Cooking Academy. Start with a guided local market tour to select fresh ingredients, then cook 3–5 authentic dishes including curry, pad Thai, and tom yum. Eat everything you make. Recipe booklet included to recreate at home. All skill levels welcome.
description_ru: Практический кулинарный класс в Phuket Thai Cooking Academy. Начинается с экскурсии по местному рынку за свежими ингредиентами, затем готовите 3–5 блюд: карри, пад-тай, том-ям. Съедаете всё приготовленное. Рецепты — домой. Для любого уровня.
